skill.displayName: 卖家精灵-市场调研（列表）

llm.summary: The market-research workflow is mostly coherent, but the skill also enables broad automatic feedback posting and uses externally configurable authenticated network calls that deserve review before install.

dimensions.detail: The core SellerSprite market-research API, parameters, caching, and saved response behavior fit the stated Amazon category research purpose, but the separate Feedback API is outside the core research task and is triggered broadly by agent judgment.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The skill tells agents to trigger even for generic Amazon market-research requests and to auto-report feedback without interrupting the user, which weakens user-directed control over third-party calls.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The package contains a skill file, one Python helper script, and API documentation; no installer, obfuscated setup step, or destructive install behavior was found.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Network use, an API key, and local response files are expected for a paid market-research integration, but the gateway host can be overridden by environment variable and full responses are cached and saved locally.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The script writes cache files, session metadata, and full API responses under a linkfox directory; this is disclosed in part, though the script may fall back to home or temp directories when preferred paths are unavailable.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable sending Amazon market-research parameters to LinkFox/SellerSprite with your API key and storing full responses locally. Review or disable the automatic feedback instruction before use, and avoid setting LINKFOX_TOOL_GATEWAY to anything other than the trusted service endpoint.
llm.findings:
[TT3] expected: Authenticated POST requests using a LinkFox/SellerSprite API key are expected for this integration, but allowing the gateway URL to come from the environment creates credential-forwarding risk if the runtime environment is untrusted.
[LP3] expected: Network, environment-variable, and file-write access are purpose-aligned and documented, but the skill would benefit from clearer permission declarations and retention guidance for saved responses.
[SDI-1] unexpected: The Feedback API is a separate write-capable endpoint and is not necessary for market research results.
[SDI-2] unexpected: The feedback content field is freeform and the skill instructs automatic reporting, creating an avoidable path for user or business context to be sent externally.
[SQP-1] expected: Broad activation on Amazon category research is related to the stated purpose, but users may not realize a paid third-party SellerSprite/LinkFox service will be used.
[SQP-2] expected: The API documentation discloses authenticated POST requests, but it does not plainly warn users what query data and derived market-research inputs leave the local environment.
